title: Read before purchasing
text: Read before purchasing. Make sure this is what you want because you have to pay to return it. About $15.00. Rarely do I return anything but you can only spot clean this item. I wish I had seen this prior to purchase because that is a deal breaker for me. Who doesn't want to clean their bedding. Crazy!

product_metadata.title: Madison Park Quilt Set Luxurious Jacquard Stripes Design - All Season, Coverlet Bedspread Lightweight Bedding Layer, Shams, Decorative Pillow, Full/Queen(90"x90"), Floral Red 5 Piece
features: To add a touch of richness to your current décor, the Princeton 5 Piece Reversible Jacquard Coverlet Set can update your room in seconds.
Jacquard design, the coverlet and shams share leaf, striping and medallion motifs that are accentuated by channel stitching.
Naturally LIGHTWEIGHT & BREATHABLE Bedding PERFECT FOR SUMMER use or layer it on for cold weather.
Set includes: 1 Coverlet: 90"W x 90"L, 2 Pillows: 18"W x 18"L/12"W x 18"L, 2 Standard Shams: 20"W x 26"L + 2"D
description: To add a touch of richness to your current decor, the Princeton Coverlet Set can update your room in seconds. Made from polyester jacquard, the coverlet and shams share leaf, striping and medallion motifs that are accentuated by channel stitching on a chocolate brown base.
